title: DOW-UAP-D085_Transmission-of-CIA-Scientific-Advisory-Panel-Rept_1953
doc_notes: This document is a transmission of the 1953 CIA Scientific Advisory Panel report on Unidentified Flying Objects to the Secretary of Defense, which concludes that UAP do not pose a direct physical threat to national security but recommends reducing their 'aura of mystery' to prevent public hysteria and communication clogging.
